source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: At the close of your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), gain 1 YP per objective you control outside your deployment zone with a friendly IRON-MASTER or MEMNYR STRATEGIST model in range. This yield caps at 2 YP per turn. You may spend 1 YP in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) whenever you pick a unit with BRÔKHYR, ARKANYST EVALUATOR or IRONKIN STEELJACKS to fire. That unit’s models can re-roll [Hit results](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) of 1 for the remainder of the phase.

requiresAll: one or more models in range from own army with either listed identity

spend.at: selection to shoot in your Shooting phase
